authorization.speaker: user (Steve)
authorization.context: Explicit acceptance after audit 160; GCD and cached method dispatch only. The full GF packet 761f1cc1 is not covered.

observations: O-12: generic bignum UVSET is limited to nonnegative target fixnum digits; native admits every unsigned 32-bit digit. Wider values refuse with code 5; half-digit stores remain the supported wide path.

O-13: the KERNEL-RESTART source arm is a host adaptation. Hooks receive NIL for the unavailable native frame pointer; the numeric wrong-type fallback is bounded, and other kernel codes signal SIMPLE-ERROR. The historical proposal modified isolated CCL source but did not integrate it.
Audit-160 F1: canonical condition replay must use its pinned source revision rather than current integrated files. The repair is separately verified; no old execution credit changes.
The full standard-GF proposal remains unreviewed. Generic GCD/ABS, condition CPL matching and image/READY are still owed.
